data.title: TypeSafe request JSON · edit state and questions

data.message: Invalid evaluation request at questions: must not have fewer than 1 properties. Expected { state, questions: { <id>: { type: "choice", instructions, criteria: { label: description|null } } | { type: "score", instructions, criteria: [level0, level1, ...] } | { type: "noul", instructions } } }; 1–32 questions, Choice 1–64 options, Score 2–32 levels.
